caveats: The decider convention is a total computable function on natural codes, correct on genuine bounded typed inputs; answers elsewhere are unrestricted. No separate named-text serialization or equivalence with partial algorithms promised to halt only on valid inputs is claimed.
No all-ground free-variable conclusion, stronger many-one/co-RE completeness classification, runtime bound, arbitrary perturbed-control result or whole-paper completion is promoted.
The local evidence is the exact 654-module supplier closure with successful native source rows and standard-axiom audits. It is not a full-root build or remote CI result.
